abstract: Digitalization is changing the way we work today, driven primarily by digital and data-driven technologies and methodologies such as Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE). MBSE focuses on formal models of a system to manage complexity and system properties. By analyzing and integrating data from various sources, system models, underlying development processes, and the later product can be optimized. Although the potentials are many, the research, integration, and application of data-driven methods, such as data analytics, into MBSE is rare. Hence, this study aims to define the aspects, potentials, and challenges of data-driven model-based systems engineering. In order to answer our research questions, a comprehensive systematic literature review is performed. Based on the results, a detailed initial description of data-driven model-based systems engineering with six aspects is deduced. In addition, the potentials, and challenges of data-driven model-based systems engineering are identified. The aspects, potentials, and challenges enable a closer look at the topic and at the same time reveal future demands and a new research area.

articleTitle: Inter-organizational collaboration and optimal cognitive proximity: Moderating effect of knowledge complexity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Technology Management, Operations and Decisions (ICTMOD)
abstract: As a result of increased specialization due to the expansion of human knowledge, collaborative learning to acquire new knowledge is becoming important. In order to find partners for effective learning, organizations need to consider the optimal level of cognitive proximity considering the complexity of the field of collaboration. This study examines the two-sided effects of cognitive proximity in the context of collaborative innovation, focusing on the moderating effect of knowledge complexity. Utilizing USPTO patent data of US biotechnology sector, this research confirmed an inverse U-shaped effect of cognitive proximity on collaborative innovation. The optimal level of cognitive proximity increases with higher level of knowledge complexity, which shows positive moderating effect of complexity on the proximity effect. The marginal effect of cognitive proximity also increases in complex fields, indicating that proximity plays stronger role as knowledge complexity increases. This indicates that while cognitive proximity enhances knowledge absorption, the presence of knowledge complexity hinders knowledge diffusion. Organizations that share more complex knowledge can achieve optimal collaborative performance by partnering with cognitively close counterparts. However, collaboration performance is lower than lower complex fields, even if organization achieve optimal cognitive distance. These insights offer valuable implications for collaboration strategies for organizations and provide guidance for policymakers and stakeholders in fostering innovation networks and creating supportive ecosystems.

articleTitle: Towards a Data-Driven Product Management – Concepts, Advantages, and Future Research
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Technology Management, Operations and Decisions (ICTMOD)
abstract: Megatrends, such as digitization or sustainability, are confronting the product management of manufacturing companies with a variety of challenges regarding the design of future products, but also the management of the actual products. To successfully position their products in the market, product managers need to gather and analyze comprehensive information about customers, developments in the products’ environment, product usage, and more. The digitization of all aspects of life is making data on these topics increasingly available – via social media, documents, or the internet of things from the products themselves. The systematic collection and analysis of these data enable the exploitation of new potentials for the adaption of existing products and the creation of the products of tomorrow. However, there are still no insights into the main concepts and cause-effect relationships in exploiting data-driven approaches for product management. Therefore, this paper aims to identify the main concepts and advantages of data-driven product management. To answer the corresponding research questions a comprehensive systematic literature review is conducted. From its results, a detailed description of the main concepts of data-driven product management is derived. Furthermore, a taxonomy for the advantages of data-driven product management is presented. The main concepts and the taxonomy allow for a deeper understanding of the topic while highlighting necessary future actions and research needs.

articleTitle: Challenges of SME Exporting: A Case Study of a Halal Food Manufacturer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Technology Management, Operations and Decisions (ICTMOD)
abstract: Muslim food demand increased by 3.1% in 2019 from $1.13 trillion to $1.17 trillion, then dropped in 2020 before increasing by 3.5% CAGR over five years to $1.38 trillion in 2024. Even though Malaysia has the most extensive halal ecosystem in the world, it only makes up a small part of the world's export value. As of 2020, Malaysia is the 19<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> largest exporter in the world. The purpose of this article is to examine the challenges of small and medium enterprises (SME) producing and exporting halal foods. This study makes use of exploratory research to assess the challenges of SME in this domain. An in-depth individual interview with an expert was done and the selection criteria of the participant was based on the SME involved in halal export. Jalen Sdn Bhd was the selected SME entity in this research topic. The interview's concepts, themes, and patterns were investigated using thematic analysis, while extracting the codes, the Nvivo 12 Pro software was used. The primary outcome of this study is assess the challenges of SME producing and exporting halal food: difficulty of acquiring halal-certified raw material and obtaining Good Manufacturing Practise (GMP) and Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) certification. By recognizing these challenges will help SME looking for solutions. Hence, SMEs in Malaysia can maximise export volume, produce more revenue, and close the economic gap, all of which help make Malaysia a sustainable economy.

articleTitle: Unravelling FinTech Lending: Risks, Transparency and Sustainable Growth in Modern India
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Technology Management, Operations and Decisions (ICTMOD)
abstract: In recent years, fintech lending practices have experienced a remarkable surge in popularity within the Indian financial sector. These innovative approaches have provided unparalleled access to credit for individuals and businesses, revolutionizing the traditional lending landscape. However, the increasing prevalence of aggressive lending practices has raised significant concerns. As such, this study delves into the intricacies of these practices and their potential risks, emphasizing the critical importance of effective risk management and responsible lending within this evolving fintech landscape. Against the backdrop of these emerging trends, our study's significance in current times cannot be overstated. It seeks to offer invaluable insights into the multifaceted ramifications of aggressive lending practices. By conducting a comprehensive analysis, we aim to equip industry stakeholders with a deeper understanding of the challenges and opportunities associated with these practices. In doing so, we enable them to make well-informed decisions and play a pivotal role in shaping a more ethical, innovative, and sustainable fintech ecosystem that aligns with the evolving needs of India's financial landscape.

articleTitle: Project Management Framework for Digitalization of Logistics Processes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Technology Management, Operations and Decisions (ICTMOD)
abstract: The review focuses on the impact of digitalization on logistics processes and the role of project management in facilitating successful digitalization initiatives. Existing studies highlight the transformative power of digitalization in the logistics industry, with scholars emphasizing the integration of advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence, big data analytics, and cloud computing etc. These technologies enable real-time data collection, analysis, and decision-making, leading to improved operational efficiency, cost reduction, and enhanced customer experiences. The alignment of digitalization efforts with business strategies, organizational goals, and competitive advantage is also underscored. Furthermore, the literature identifies various challenges and considerations in the digitalization of logistics process, such as business complexity, organizational maturity, and the need for robust risk management practices. Scholars emphasize the importance of addressing these factors to ensure smooth digitalization implementation and mitigate potential risks. These articles provide valuable insights into the subject matter and contribute to the body of knowledge on digitalization, logistics, and project management.

articleTitle: Freight Mode Choice Criteria Identification and Prioritization Using MCDM and SP Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Technology Management, Operations and Decisions (ICTMOD)
abstract: Freight transportation is crucial for efficient supply chain operations, ensuring the smooth movement and timely availability of products. A key decision in freight transportation management is selecting the optimal transportation mode and route for freight movement. This decision-making process involves identifying relevant performance criteria, selecting the most suitable mode of transport and route, negotiating rates and service levels, and assessing performance. Logistics managers play a vital role in making these decisions and should possess a comprehensive understanding of the various factors, both quantitative and qualitative, that influence freight mode choice. This knowledge is essential for effective decision-making and the formulation of policies that encourage the adoption of sustainable transportation modes. For decades, road transportation has been the leading mode of inland freight transportation. However, intermodal transportation, which combines road transport with other modes of transportation, offers the potential for reduced operating costs and improved environmental sustainability. The objective of this research is to systematically review the existing literature on decision-making processes regarding modal choices in intermodal freight transportation.

articleTitle: The Blockchain Revolution: Disrupting Derivative Markets with Smart Contracts
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Technology Management, Operations and Decisions (ICTMOD)
abstract: The derivative trading market is a critical component of the global financial system, and its efficiency and fairness directly affect market participants. The adoption of blockchain and smart contracts in this domain has the potential to revolutionise the way derivatives are traded, benefiting both businesses and investors. This research paper explores blockchain technology's and smart contracts' potential transformative impact on the derivative trading market. It aims to investigate how these technologies can enhance transparency, efficiency, and security while reducing fraud and errors in derivative trading. The study employs a literature review and analysis of current trends and developments in blockchain and smart contract technology. It also considers case studies and pilot projects in the financial industry to understand the practical implications. The research reveals that while the adoption of blockchain and smart contracts in the derivative trading market is in its early stages, there is a growing interest among businesses and investors. As the technology matures, it is likely to play an increasingly crucial role in enhancing the fairness and accessibility of derivative trading. The findings suggest that integrating blockchain and smart contracts in derivative trading can reshape the industry by improving transparency, efficiency, and security. Market participants and regulators should closely monitor these developments to ensure a fair and competitive marketplace. Additionally, businesses should consider the cost-saving opportunities and strategic advantages of adopting these technologies in their derivative trading operations.

articleTitle: Knowledge Networks and Organizational Resource Allocation as Antecedents for Managing Knowledge to Achieve Ambidexterity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Technology Management, Operations and Decisions (ICTMOD)
abstract: Management research has increasingly explored knowledge management's (KM) role in achieving organizational ambidexterity (OA). Despite the number of empirical and theoretical studies, the literature lacks comprehensive research on factors that impact (facilitate or impede) the use of existing or new knowledge in exploration and exploitation to achieve organizational ambidexterity. To address this research gap, the authors conducted a systematic literature review to investigate and underscore similarities and generate new perspectives on how KM contributes to OA. As a result, this paper identifies knowledge networks and organizational resource allocation as antecedents of KM in pursuing OA and that the knowledge flow (intra-firm, interfirm, M&A) facilitates or impedes the impact of (KM) to achieve (OA). Based on the results, the paper proposes a conceptual framework that elucidates new insights into the relationship between KM and OA and future research opportunities across these domains.

articleTitle: How does green human resource management influence employee engagement through the sustainable organization of air courier services providers?
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Technology Management, Operations and Decisions (ICTMOD)
abstract: Businesses have increasingly recognized the importance of employee engagement because of its positive effects on profitability, productivity, sales, absenteeism, and customer loyalty. However, the aftermath of the pandemic has presented various challenges to its implementation, such as cost-cutting, layoffs, restructuring, and staff burnout. To promote sustainability, businesses must adopt green human resource management (GHRM) and integrate it with sustainable organizational practices. Following this strategy can quickly boost employee engagement. Notably, in the logistics sector, particularly air transportation, this means rapidly focusing on sustainability awareness to reduce CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions. It is, therefore, interesting to examine this sector. This study aims to investigate the key influence of GHRM on employee engagement in sustainable organizations. The research design involves the analysis of descriptive statistics and quantitative data using a regression model. The data were collected from online convenience surveys of 351 employees working at three major air courier service providers in Thailand. The results emphasize the strong influence that GHRM has on employee engagement. To achieve this, organizations should apply the principles of GHRM in their recruitment, training and development, performance management, compensation, benefits, and welfare. To improve GHRM, an organization should focus on enhancing its environmental tracks and reporting its performance to external stakeholders. Sustainable organizations play a significant mediating role between GHRM and employee engagement, especially when organizations effectively communicate their sustainability efforts and progress on environmental aspects to stakeholders. The findings of this research provide valuable insights that can assist organizations in the air courier service provider industry in optimizing their strategies to foster and expedite employee engagement.
